title: feat(scenarios): summary reads many run records into one author-model × ask-model table per card and mode
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao4psK7Bs26AbU2eVDP8BRoL)_

epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzsmtYYYUFnXkD4pNR

Clause-②: yes (widening) — the new subcommand `summary` with its flags `--card` and `--mode`, on `objectstack-scenarios` (`bin.ts`) and `run-scenarios` (`cli.ts`), reached through the bin, not an export entry; through `./runner`: the new module `summary.ts` and its exports `SuppliedTemplate`, `SUPPLIED_TEMPLATE_SOURCE`, `suppliedTemplateOf`, `SummaryRecord`, `ReadSummaryResult`, `readSummaryRecords`, `TABLE_DIMENSIONS`, `TableDimension`, `mergeAskSpend`, `SummaryTable`, `SummaryOptions`, `summaryTables`, `renderSummaryTable`, `renderSummary`, `SUMMARY_USAGE`, `SummaryArgs`, `parseSummaryArgs`, `SummaryIo`, `summaryMain`; the new exports `withSuppliedTemplate` and `summaryMain` (re-exported) of `cli.ts`, reached by the bin's built `cli` entry, not an export-map subpath; and the run record's new optional top-level key `template` (`{ file, sha256 }`), written by `run --template F` when a template or ask mode installed that file. No export entry moves.
Metadata-protocol: none

Fixes #34295

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:跑分器新增 `objectstack-scenarios summary <记录文件|目录>…`(检出里是 `run-scenarios summary`),一次读入多份运行记录,按「卡片 × 模式」各出一张 markdown 表:行是搭建所用的模型,列是问数/操作所用的模型,格子里是汇总的 Build、问数(带 `--ask-repeats` 时附 k/N 分布)、操作通过数、迭代半场,以及问数花费和耗时。`run --template F` 现在会在记录里写下模板文件名和 sha256,让 ask 模式的行能分清是哪份构建。
- 为什么改:评测席做模型对比(哪个模型搭建 × 哪个模型问答,云端默认用 haiku 够不够)一直靠手工从记录文件拼表,慢且容易错;本命令把这张表变成一条命令。
- 风险与回滚:只读文件,不调模型、不联网,不自己打分,数字全部取自记录里的评分表。提示选择、包来源、重复次数、驱动不一致的记录不会被加在一起,而是整张表拒绝并逐条写明差异与两边的文件;老记录缺的字段写 `not recorded`,不当 0。不给 `--template` 时记录字节不变;画廊导出对带新字段的记录输出不变(已加钉子)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/summary.ts` 的 `summaryTables`(分表与拒绝)和 `suppliedAxis`(ask/template 模式的行),`src/runner/cli.ts` 的 `withSuppliedTemplate`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/runner/summary.test.ts`,预期 24 个用例全过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`summary`** (`src/runner/summary.ts`, new): reads run records from files and directories (a directory at every depth; other JSON in it, such as `*.rec.json` recordings, is skipped and listed on stderr; a file named directly that is not a run record fails the command), and prints markdown to stdout. Deterministic and offline: it reads files only, calls no model and no network, and scores nothing itself; every figure is the record's own `scorecard`'s.
- **Design point 1, input**: record files or directories of them as `runRecord` writes them. Parsing is tolerant: a record is recognised by `runner: "scenario-runner"` and a `scorecard.modes` list, and every other field it reads is optional, so a field an older record lacks reads `not recorded` (served models, ask cost and time, package source), never a crash or a zero.
- **Design point 2, axes**: one table per card and mode. Rows are the model the build's authoring turn was **served** (`Build · author`); columns are the models the question and operation turns were served (`Run · model`, first Run and iterate Run). When the asked-for name differs from the served one, both are stated (`claude-haiku-5-5 (asked for haiku)`, or `⚠ asked for sonnet` on a real mismatch); the asked-for effort joins the label when the record has it, so two efforts are two rows or columns. Template and ask modes authored no first build, so their row is the build they were supplied: the template file the record names (file name and sha256, see below); `this run’s from-scratch build` takes that run's scratch author; a record that names no template file is a row of its own, never summed with another. A template mode's row also names its iterate's author.
- **Design point 3, cells**: Runs, Build, Run-问数, Run-operations; with `--ask-repeats` also `Run-问数 · k/N per turn`, the spread of the question turns over every run of the cell (`3/3 ×7 · 2/3 ×1 · 0/3 ×1`); the Iterate halves when any run of the table iterated; then Ask cost and Ask time, the scorecard's per-mode rows (every persona turn of the mode, the iterate's included). Counts are summed. A cost or time is summed only when every run of the cell states one; otherwise the cell says `not recorded on K of N runs` or `not reported (k of n ask turns reported a cost)`, never a partial sum. A build that was not measured counts apart (`20/22 · 1 not measured`). A skipped mode is listed under its table and counts in no cell.
- **Never summed silently**: cards and modes are kept apart as separate tables. Inside a table the runs must share prompt choice, package source, ask repeats and driver (a replay is its own driver, so it never doubles its original); when they do not, the table is refused with one line per differing dimension naming each value and the files that hold it, the other tables still print, and the command exits 1. `--prompt detailed` reads as the default prompt, so it sums with a run that gave no flag.
- **Design point 4**: no model, no network: `summary.ts` imports only `node:fs`/`node:path`/`node:crypto` and the runner's own formatters (`scorecard.ts`, `packages.ts`, `prompts.ts`), imported, not changed.
- **Design point 5, output and filters**: markdown to stdout, diagnostics to stderr. `--card ID[,ID]` and `--mode M[,M]` are offered. Exit 0 when every table printed; 1 when a table was refused, a named file was not a run record, or nothing was read; 2 on a usage error.
- **The supplied template in the record** (`src/runner/cli.ts`, seat ruling 6907482043, option B): `run --template F` writes `template: { file, sha256 }` at the record's top level, after `runRecord`, when a template or ask mode installed that file: its base name (never its path) and the sha256 of the bytes `run` read. Without it, every ask-mode record says only `supplied template`, so two different builds would land in one row. A run without `--template`, or whose modes installed nothing from it, writes the same record as before. `orchestrate.ts` and `scorecard.ts` are untouched.
- **Routing**: `objectstack-scenarios summary …` (`src/bin.ts`) calls `summaryMain` through the built `cli` entry (re-exported by `cli.ts`), with the bin's own output; `run-scenarios summary …` dispatches before the run flags are parsed. `help` lists it.
- README: a `Many runs in one table — summary` section; changeset `34295-scenario-run-summary.md` (patch).

## Tests

- `test/runner/summary.test.ts` (new, 24 cases): the 2×2 matrix from fixture records (two runs summed in one cell: `42/44`, `17/18 ⚠ 1 leaking`, `7/10`, `$0.60 over 28 ask turns`, `2m 30s`); effort in the labels; a served/asked mismatch marked; Iterate rows and a run without one; a not-measured build counted apart; the k/N spread; a cost not summed when one run reported none; **the refusal on mixed prompt choices**, naming both values and both files, the other card's table still printed, exit 1; `--prompt detailed` sums with the default; package source, ask repeats and driver refused one line each; cards and modes kept apart; supplied template rows by sha256, a record naming no file a row of its own, the scratch-build and template-mode rows; `withSuppliedTemplate` writing the key only when a mode installed the supplied file; **an older record** (no served models, no ask cost/time, no package source) reading `not recorded`, and an older record beside a newer one in one cell (`not recorded on 1 of 2 runs`); directory reading at depth with recordings skipped and a file named twice read once; a named non-record and a missing path failing; `--card`/`--mode`; usage and help; `objectstack-scenarios summary` and `run-scenarios summary` reaching the same command; and a record the runner itself wrote (`runCrm`, scratch + ask on its own build) read back.
- `test/export/exporter.test.ts` (+1, new top-level describe, as the seat asked): a gallery export of a record carrying `template` is the export of the same record without it, every file and the index byte-identical, the key carried in `run-record.json` as read.

## Acceptance notes

- An effort set only through `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` was never recorded (only `--effort` / `--ask-effort` are, since #33739), so the 11-15 confirmation runs `haiku-default` and `haiku-medium` read as one row and sum. That is what the records hold; summarize those directories apart.
- Records eval#1 wrote before this PR on `--modes ask --template F` (the M2 close-out runs) name no template file, so each is a row of its own (labelled by its record file). Records written after it share a row per template.
- Ask cost and time are the scorecard's per-mode figures, which include the iterate run's persona turns; the pass-count rows show the first Run half and the Iterate halves separately. The heading line under the title says so.
- A cell sums reps of different builds by the same served author model, as scratch rows always did; only a template or ask row names one build.

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

- `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on the committed head; the tests import `src`, so there is no build leg. Each mutation was restored with `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob equal to HEAD (`2e50dba75e8e`).
  - The table refusal disabled (`values.size < 2` → `< 99`): 2 failed / 2 passed of the refusal describe (mixed prompt choices; package source, repeats and driver).
  - Every unnamed supplied build keyed as one row (`record:${file}` → `record:one`): 1 failed (a record naming no template file is a row of its own).
</details>

<details><summary>Real records (read-only, not committed)</summary>

- eval#1's 2026-11-15 model runs (9 records, 6 recordings skipped): three tables, rows and columns `claude-haiku-5-5 (asked for haiku)` / opus / sonnet, Ask cost/time `not recorded` (pre-#33740 records).
- The 2026-11-15 confirmation runs, `--card project_with_tasks` (45 records): haiku 10 runs, opus 5 runs, summed per cell.
- The 2026-11-16 M2 close-out ask record via the built bin (`node bin/objectstack-scenarios.js summary --mode ask`): `each question turn asked 3 times`, `Run-问数 · k/N per turn 3/3 ×7 · 2/3 ×1 · 0/3 ×1`, `claude-opus-5-5: $5.50 over 32 ask turns`, its row `supplied template, file not recorded (record …)`.
</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios^...' build` :: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` :: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test` :: exit 0 (lock VERDICT command-exit 0): 35 test files passed (35), 955 tests passed (955), on `26132ae3`. A first run without the package's own `dist/` failed only the two `test/build/*` files on their prerequisite ("build @objectstack/scenarios first"); after the build all 35 passed.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the six touched TS files :: exit 0.
- The built bin: `node bin/objectstack-scenarios.js summary --mode ask <M2 close-out dir>` :: exit 0, and `help` lists `summary`.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `26132ae3`, 8 paths, 62 families), each run with stdin from `/dev/null`: 60 exit 0, and 2 exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET):
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` could not read its pinned fixture commit in the shallow clone. After `git fetch origin 621a4876…`, a rerun exited 0 ("48 cases pass"), recorded on its own line; the first-run record is kept as it was.
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` is NOT MEASURED locally: it needs every package's `dist/`. CI runs it.
  - `--ran` on the first-run record: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 60 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".
- Main (`8898b4e3` → `a00b4228`) was merged once before opening (`26132ae3`); it touched nothing under `packages/qa/scenarios`.
- 1,150 changed lines (+1,146/-4) in 8 files. No governed surface; `packages/spec`, `orchestrate.ts`, `scorecard.ts`, `src/score/**`, `src/schema.ts`, card JSONs and `src/export/**` untouched (the exporter gets one test, no source change).
</details>
